decision: Current canonical source cannot implement the conditionally signed six-loop V2.2 envelope without an authority-approved source/net/component correction.

authority_dependencies.need: Select one 12-V-rated active current-limit/protection stage for A-F and prove its worst-case maximum is <=6.4 A; decide LM74700/Q retention or replacement.
Qualify exact six-header/mating assembly, wire/crimp/length/loop resistance, thermal installation and fuse I2t coordination.
Assign collision-free C-F source references and component cohorts/positions within the current fixed-anchor/corridor plan.
Index/provenance the authoritative current-limiter and exact package evidence before authority signature.

research_lead_not_selection.facts: 4.5-60 V operation, adjustable 0.6-6 A current limit, +/-7%, 31 mOhm typical integrated FET, 20-pin HTSSOP option
research_lead_not_selection.reason_not_closed: 6 A setting upper limit is 6.42 A, so it does not by itself prove a guaranteed <=6.4 A branch limit.

producer_resume.resume_when: Exact source/net/component contract and exact assembly qualification are recorded; then one isolated producer may modify source and PCB.
